resolved_failure_path: The closer now accepts an optional actual session ID with default null, while actual exit code and root tool evidence remain mandatory. A synchronous early setup failure can therefore be closed without inventing a session; the successful nine-job path is unchanged.
verified_source_contracts: Nine cut-major jobs use the same exact protected regression LightGBM SINGLE. Each recipe is a deep copy with only params.loss_profile_id added for fixed L2, L1 or Huber(alpha=.9). FE/history, target transform, weights, seed, stopping and iteration limits stay fixed.

The three immutable existing forward split files, five pristine task files, rebound spec paths, exact job JSON, archive and deployed module hashes are bound before workers. No HPO, Qwen calls, feature search, weight sweep, extra refit or extra learner is introduced.

The sole quality control is a freshly measured explicit L2 on the same cut. Each non-L2 profile must strictly lower original-scale RMSE on all three cuts. All nine workers must succeed for whole-screen quality qualification; failed/null cuts cannot pass. Historical SINGLE parity is separate optional evidence.

The independent auditor binds and rehashes all nine saved terminal supervisors and complete artifact inventories before parsing pristine labels. Frozen R4 verifies saved row positions, predictions, test output and manual metrics; the new telemetry verifier independently reconstructs the nested numeric-period partition and fitting-parent hashes.

Each successful result must contain exactly two actual post-fit Booster receipts with fit indices/scopes, objective, fixed Huber alpha, nonempty disabled-default-metric evidence, LightGBM4.6.0, original RMSE and the actual original/log1p target scale. Silent inner fallback cannot qualify.

The one exclusive launch clock is 7200 wall/monotonic seconds: setup900 + nine600-second parents + audit600 + cleanup/root300. Worker children have570 seconds; source checks, launch overhead and sealing are charged within their parent. Admission reserves the remaining declared work. No retry, reset or reinvestment path exists.
The reviewed serial supervisor, two worker threads/one BLAS thread, worker1.5GiB/tree2GiB limits, stripped API credentials, strict known-identity checks and canonical training lock are reused.

Actual LOSS00 closure99080/exit0 and source487/exact23/flat16 readiness are pinned and reused with fresh source hashes. Both queue failure/recovery proofs and original METH02 null-session/exit1 remain explicit. Any later intervening job needs its real extra terminal proof.

Partial/failed artifacts and null metrics remain in their declared slots. Systemic/resource/ownership/integrity failures stop qualification; late technical failure clears live quality fields. The root closer rehashes deployment, seals, supervisors and audit references and freshly rejects live or uncertain known identities under the original deadline.
limits: This is an execution-readiness source review, not actual worker, cleanup, elapsed-cost or quality evidence. Root review/publication, fresh ownership closure and one future launch are still required.
The public cuts are reused component screens. Even an all-cut positive result is not blind/private performance, whole-agent gain, full-refit qualification, promotion or an official score.
The root must observe the coordinator and closer actual terminal exits and freshly confirm closer preparer absence; a receipt alone is not that observation.
